question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Causes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Causes**" refers to the factors or reasons that bring about a particular effect, result, or outcome. (**कारण**)
 
• It signifies the underlying elements or circumstances that lead to a specific event or condition.
 
 
• **Example**: *The causes of the economic downturn were complex and multifaceted.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Thoughts**" refer to mental processes involving ideas, opinions, or considerations within one's mind. (**विचार**)
 
• "**Things**" is a broad term referring to objects, items, or matters. (**सामान**)
 
• "**Types**" categorize items or concepts into different classifications or groups. (**प्रकार**)
